params.body:
## Summary

- Add a fourth sort group to the own-stock list's "Sorteer op" menu: intern nummer, ascending and descending. The column is text but sorts numerically (`CAST AS UNSIGNED`), with empty values always sorted last regardless of direction.
- Remove the unused manual XML import: the "Hulpmiddelen" menu entry, the two header buttons (classic create/edit page), the modal and confirmation views, both routes and both controller methods. `ImportVehicle::doImport` stays — the Modix API import (R P3-6.2) still uses it. Logged as a finding (`docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-xml-import-uit-eigen-wagenpark.md`).
- Replace the five tri-state Alle/Ja/Nee segmented filters (In optie, Op stock, Klaar voor keuring, Gepubliceerd, Car-Pass) with plain selects so they stack cleanly on a phone; same Livewire property names and values.
- Fix the "duplicate vehicle" confirmation: it read "Item kopiëren" with an unfilled `:item` placeholder and "Export " glued in front of the brand. It now names the vehicle (brand, model, year) and states accurately what carries over — options and photos are copied, Car-Pass and portal assignments are not (verified against `OwnStockController::duplicateVehicle`, not guessed). Added a busy state to the duplicate buttons (`wire:loading`) so the confirm-to-redirect gap reads as working rather than frozen.
- Turn the "In optie" status chip into a button that releases the option on the spot, reusing the existing guarded action (`OwnStockList::setNotInOption`, dealer-owned only) instead of requiring the row's ⋯ menu first; confirms, then notifies, then the row re-renders.

## Test plan

- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'OwnStockListTest|OwnStockHeaderMenusTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|AlpineExpressionTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest'` — green.
- [x] Full `vendor/bin/phpunit` — no new failures (pre-existing failures in unrelated suites, same before and after this branch).
- [x] Manual pass in a running instance: sort by intern nummer (asc/desc, empty last), Hulpmiddelen menu without XML import, filter panel selects, duplicate confirm + redirect to the new concept's edit sheet, release the option from the chip.
- [x] Screenshots at 1440px and 390px (sort menu, tools menu, filter panel, duplicate confirm, option-release confirm).
params.title: Own stock: sort by internal number, drop the XML import, filters as selects
